title: Explored generating a cohesive 16-bit pixel art weapon set with 3 progression tiers (Steel, Mythril, Legendary). Here's the final visual result!
author: LoreCraft_Assets
selftext:
Hey everyone! I've been experimenting with creating a structured 16-bit pixel art weapon collection using generative AI.

The main goal was maintaining **style consistency** across different weapon types and progression tiers (from basic Steel to Mythril, up to Legendary/Elemental items with aura effects).

**Workflow summary:**

1. Generated base silhouettes and color schemes.
2. Cleaned up color palettes to match a retro RPG 16-bit grid constraint.
3. Categorized into distinct tiers for game balance.

Happy to answer any questions about the style consistency or asset structuring! *(Note: Links available on my Reddit profile if anyone's curious).*
